title: AUDIOLOGS from FOC
description: This mod adds all audiologists from the legendary game "Transformers fall of cybertron" with the opportunity to listen to them!
body: Have you ever dreamed of combining "Transformers: fall of cybertron" and Minecraft? You will get closer to that goal with this mod! It adds all audiologs from FOC! To listen to them, you need to use a turntable. 51 recordings are available for listening! New texture and a separate tab in the inventory!
